argv:
'pids=$(pidof thalesmms.logisim.mobile.e2e); echo PIDS:$pids
for p in $pids; do
 echo PROCESS:$p; cat /proc/$p/stat; cat /proc/$p/io; cat /proc/$p/status
 for t in /proc/$p/task/*; do echo THREAD:$t; cat "$t/stat"; cat "$t/wchan"; echo; done
done'
